title: feat(ui): the remaining Studio inspector strings and the package, form and editor strings move into the studio i18n namespace (#25922 slice S3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PeP4DzppH3b1kDPCjihHVx)_

Part of #25922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 设计器表里剩余的 `engine.inspector.*`（223 键）以及全部 `engine.packages.*`、`engine.form.*`、`engine.edit.*` 从 app-shell 私有表搬进 `@object-ui/i18n` 的 `studio` 命名空间，共 en 551 键、zh 560 键（多出的 9 个 `engine.packages.form.help.*` 按原样保持仅 zh），文案一字未改，调用点不动。
- 为什么改：执行 #25922 裁决 6431032267（Q2 = A，6431234244 维持），这是 (M) 的第 3 片（S3），派单 6447417545。
- 风险与回滚：与前两片相同，zh 用户首次打开这些编辑器时标签先显示英文、zh 分片到达后同一挂载重渲染为中文；回滚即 revert 本 PR，行原样回到 app-shell。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` 末尾新加的 S3 段（含仅 zh 行的说明），再看 `inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts` 的四个新家族下限与仅 zh 断言。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm run check:i18n-designer-parity && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`，应全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Slice S3 of the (M) item.** Every remaining `engine.inspector.*` row and every `engine.packages.*`, `engine.form.*` and `engine.edit.*` row leaves `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is appended to `STUDIO_EN` / `STUDIO_ZH` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, text byte-for-byte unchanged:

  | family | `en` | `zh` |
  |---|---|---|
  | `engine.inspector.*` (the rest after S2) | 223 | 223 |
  | `engine.packages.*` | 133 | 142 |
  | `engine.form.*` | 98 | 98 |
  | `engine.edit.*` | 97 | 97 |
  | **total** | **551** | **560** |

  Same AST pass as S2 (each property with its leading comment block; a mixed group's comment moves only when the group's first row moves); a heading comment marks the S3 section in each catalogue. After this slice no `engine.inspector.*` row is left in the app-shell table.
- **zh-only rows stay zh-only.** The nine `engine.packages.form.help.*` rows have no `en` entry, before and after: their English is the package schema's own `.describe()` sentence, read through `tOptional`. `check:i18n-designer-parity` already lists the family in `ZH_ONLY_FAMILIES`; the zh heading comment says why the rows have no `en` twin.
- **No runtime change.** `lookupString` already asks the table first and the namespace second (slice 1), so `t` / `tFormat` / `tOptional` and every call site are untouched. No new file, so the console's `i18n-ns-studio-en` / `i18n-ns-studio-zh` chunk groups need no change.
- **Readers.** Every reader of the moved keys is in app-shell. All but one are Studio surfaces (metadata-admin, inspectors, previews, studio-design). The exception is `views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` (`engine.edit.*`). It sits outside Studio, but it reads its locale through `useMetadataLocale()`, which re-renders when the `zh` catalogue lands, the same path the Studio surfaces take. So it needs no await. Dynamic keys (`engine.inspector.appNav.type.${…}`, `engine.packages.source.${…}`, `engine.inspector.view.type.${…}`) all go through `t()`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/25922-studio-i18n-editor-chrome.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
- ⛔ Untouched: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, `ui/.github/**`, root `ci.yml`, and every file PR #26800 owns (`inspectorStrings.i18n-10804`, the three `FlowNodeInspector` tests, `datasetPickers.authorText-11161`, `FlowPreview.removeNode-11772`, `flow-problems.removalRefusal-11838`, `previewStrings.i18n-10848`, `metadataError.heldWidget-11910`). None of them needed a preload for this slice.

## Why

Ruling 6431032267 Q2 = A (upheld by 6431234244): the designer table becomes one lazy `@object-ui/i18n` namespace, moved in slices; S3 is the third row of #26593's slice table.

## Tests

Widened:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`: four new per-family floors (`engine.inspector.` 700, `engine.packages.` 120, `engine.form.` 90, `engine.edit.` 90, beside S2's six), so one family draining cannot hide behind another. Per family, the namespace carries every key in `en` and `zh`, and `t()` answers every key with the namespace's value in `en-US`, `zh-CN` and `de-DE`. New case: the `engine.packages.form.help.*` rows (at least 9) are absent from `en`, `tOptional(k, 'zh-CN')` returns the `zh` value, and `tOptional(k, 'en-US')` stays `undefined`.

Forced edits: the zh rows these suites assert synchronously now arrive in the lazily fetched chunk. Each suite makes `zh` resident with a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`; no assertion changed. All files are under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`:

- 19 dom suites: `AuditPanel.loadFailure`, `IconPickerWidget.unknownName-12531`, `PackageFormDialog` (+ `.helpTextI18n`, `.idDerive-11792`), `PackagesPage.installedApps-13356`, `ResourceEditPage.pickerLoadFailure` / `.referencesColumns-25916` / `.referencesErrorState`, `SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218`, `datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.selectPlaceholderLocale-11252`, `inspectors/DashboardDefaultInspector`, `inspectors/FlowReferenceField.flag.i18n-10448`, `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.flag.i18n-10448`, `inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector` (+ `.i18nTitle`), `inspectors/unknownValueFlag.i18n-9652`, `previews/previewStrings.i18n-10835`, `selector-placeholder.i18n`.
- 1 unit suite: `artifact-locked-banner.i18n.test.ts`. The `unit` project runs with `isolate: false`, so in the full run this suite passed only because an earlier file in the same worker had already loaded `zh`. Run alone, it failed. I found it by running each of the 34 unit-project tests that name a zh locale on its own; the other 33 pass alone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Every moved key resolves identically before and after.** This was a one-off measurement and is not committed. I read the 551 + 560 values by AST from the base table at `f7c95cd1`. I then compared them with `t()` and `tOptional()` on this branch after `zh` is resident. The `en` value was checked in `en-US`, `en`, `de-DE` and `fr`. The `zh` value was checked in `zh-CN`, `zh` and `zh-TW`. Each lookup checked both `t()` and `tOptional()`. The nine zh-only rows were also checked in `en-US` and `de-DE`, where `t()` must echo the key and `tOptional()` must return `undefined`, as before. That is 3,902 lookups, 0 differing.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count and blob, restored byte-identical to `HEAD`):
  - With the `?? studioString(key, locale)` arm removed from `lookupString`, 12 tests go red (11 in the pin across all ten families plus the zh-only case, and the equivalence check). The equivalence check reports 3,884 of 3,902 lookups differing. The 18 that hold are the zh-only rows in `en-US` and `de-DE`, whose expected answer is "not found" either way.
  - With one moved zh row altered (`engine.edit.publish`), the equivalence check reports exactly 3 differing lookups (`zh-CN`, `zh`, `zh-TW`). The pin stays green, as designed, because its oracle is the catalogue itself.
- **Eager bundle: not re-measured locally.** The namespace's only non-test importer is app-shell's `i18n.ts`, which imports it statically. So the moved `en` rows sit behind the same import edge before and after, and the `zh` rows stay in the lazy `i18n-ns-studio-zh` chunk. CI's `Build & E2E UI` runs the eager-closure budget on the built console.

## Verification

All at `61332921`.

<details><summary>Affected tests</summary>

- Before the forced edits, under `os-verify-lock`, I ran 341 test files: every app-shell test naming a zh locale, every file naming one of the four families, the i18n namespace tests and the ui i18n script tests. 322 passed and 19 failed, all of them the zh-synchronous suites above.
- After the edits, I reran the 21 touched or new files: `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 205 passed (205)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Unit-project isolation loop: each of the 34 unit tests that name a zh locale, run alone, exits 0 after the `artifact-locked-banner` preload.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (both tsconfigs in each package).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands. Each exited 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (`Test Files 178 passed | 2 skipped (180)`). `--ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- ui: `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-keys` all exit 0, and `check:i18n-drift` reports 0 `en` values changed in the locale packs and in the designer table. `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0 (0 new citations). `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- Changed lines: 2,770 (+1,454 / −1,316) over 25 files, under the 3,000 threshold.

</details>
